messages:
leah-support: FYI Hemlock Health opened an escalation — they say audit exports are missing KMS envelope IDs after a retention purge. BAA customer, wants immediate preservation and HSM attestation. Ticket H-7218. cc @dinesh-sre @maya-security

leah-support: on it. can you paste the exact export API call + response they saw?

leah-support: customer pasted this: 
```
GET /v1/audit/exports?start=2026-10-01&end=2026-11-01&format=ndjson
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"export_failed","details":"missing_kms_envelope_id for 12 records"}
```
They also said zip contains ndjson with some records that lack "envelope_kid" field.

hemant-eng: quick hypothesis — key rotation or archived keys not surfaced to export job. repro steps requested: 1) run export via API 2) inspect ndjson for null envelope_kid 3) check kms key history for those object IDs.

leah-support: they ran the console export (Reports → Audit → Export) and the downloaded zip had 3 files: events.ndjson, objects.ndjson, manifest.json. objects.ndjson had ~3k lines, ~12 lines missing envelope_kid. customer insists these are recent and should still be available.

maya-security: tagging contract/BAA note — hemock's addendum (BAA-HEM-2025) mandates 7yr retention for audit logs. Our retention purge for non-provisioned accounts is 180d unless retention override present. do we have a retention override for them? @julie-legal can you confirm contract terms?

julie-legal: I have BAA-HEM-2025 in the queue. will confirm retention clause and any signed addendum by end of day. if we missed a contractual retention override we need to preserve and rehydrate immediately. pls attach customer contract id to the ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-245: Hemlock audit export missing KMS envelope IDs. Priority: P1 (customer-impacting).

dinesh-sre: while legal checks contract, quick triage: run internal export that includes archived/rotated keys: 
```
POST /internal/exports/adhoc
{
  "customer_id":"hemlock",
  "include_archived_keys":true,
  "time_range":{"start":"2026-10-01","end":"2026-11-01"}
}
```
I can run this and surface any envelope_kid fields that were dropped by the public exporter.

hemant-eng: also check KMS key rotation log for the account: internal command `redis-cli HGETALL kms:hemlock:keys` then query HSM attestation logs `cat /var/log/hsm/attestation.log | grep hemlock | tail -n 200`. possible race during rotation where envelope metadata wasn't copied to cold store.

leah-support: customer also flagged a billing spike on 2026-11-02 near the time they requested a large export; they want credits if our export triggered duplicate processing. cc @sam-finance

sam-finance: looking at usage — there was a usage jump 2026-11-02 03:12 UTC: +1.2M token-equivalent for hemock-export-job-998. appears to be a retry loop from their side (429s then automatic retries) that caused doubled compute usage. we can propose a one-off credit if our internal export confirms we reprocessed archived objects.

maya-security: next steps: (1) dinesh run ad-hoc internal export and attach ndjson to ticket (2) hemant gather KMS/HSM rotation logs and any envelope key lifecycle events (3) julie confirm contractual retention obligation (4) finance consider credit if our system caused reprocessing. I'll prepare HSM attestation package (FIPS cert + key-rotation audit) once logs confirmed. ETA 6h for initial package.

dinesh-sre: ad-hoc export started — job id internal-exp-3291. attaching sample lines from objects.ndjson (scrubbed): 
```
{"object_id":"obj_abc123","timestamp":"2026-10-15T12:03:22Z","envelope_kid":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd"}
{"object_id":"obj_def456","timestamp":"2026-10-20T08:11:10Z","envelope_kid":null}  # missing
```
We have nulls for the 12 records reported. investigating why envelope_kid is null while manifest references key.

hemant-eng: confirmed key rotation at 2026-10-20 08:10 UTC for customer-managed key `hemlock-key-rot-01`. looks like rotation job ran at same second as a batch retention job; possible race where metadata update failed to persist. sending patch to add stricter durable writes on metadata writes.

leah-support: customer asked for immediate preservation and official confirmation of what records are affected. I've told them we're collecting artifacts and will send attestation + re-export where possible. they asked for ETA for rehydration.

maya-security: I'll assemble the attestation docs and provide the HSM vendor chain and key-rotation audit for the window 2026-10-19..2026-10-21. once legal confirms retention obligation we can prioritize full rehydrate.

julie-legal: contract confirms 7yr retention override on 2025-06-30 amendment. escalate to exec if we failed SLA. I'll prepare a notice and coordinate remedial plan.

sam-finance: pre-approved credit cap for P1 escalations is $50k; will hold until engineering confirms reprocessing cause.

leah-support: thanks team. I'll keep customer updated: initial evidence + ETA for attestation in ~6h. adding ticket notes and pinging Hemlock primary contact. :white_check_mark:
